target: Mohon konfirmasi kehadiran Anda paling lambat hari Jumat.
english: Please confirm your attendance by Friday at the latest.
tip: Paling lambat is literally 'at the slowest', and it means 'at the latest': konfirmasi paling lambat hari Jumat – the deadline phrase of letters and forms.

target: Kami mohon maaf atas kesalahan penulisan pada surat sebelumnya.
english: We apologize for the writing error in the previous letter.
tip: kesalahan penulisan = 'clerical error', letter-speak — spoken: ada salah ketik.

target: Surat lamaran dan riwayat hidup dapat dikirim melalui email kantor.
english: Application letters and CVs can be sent via the office email.
tip: riwayat hidup = 'curriculum vitae' — job-application word; people just say CV.

target: Demikian surat ini kami buat, atas kerja samanya kami ucapkan terima kasih.
english: Thus we have written this letter; we thank you for your cooperation.
tip: Demikian ... = 'thus ends this letter', the classic closing line of official letters.

target: Kepada Yang Terhormat Ibu Sari di tempat.
english: To the Honorable Mrs. Sari, at her address.
tip: di tempat on an envelope = 'at your address' — used when the writer skips the full address.

target: Kami sampaikan bahwa kantor akan tutup selama libur Lebaran.
english: We hereby inform you that the office will be closed during the Lebaran holiday.
tip: bahwa = 'that' introducing a clause — written style; conversation usually drops it.

target: Mohon hadir tepat waktu karena rapat akan dimulai pukul sembilan.
english: Please be present on time because the meeting will start at nine.
tip: hadir = formal 'datang' — meeting language; spoken: datang ya, jangan telat.

target: Berdasarkan hasil rapat, kegiatan tahunan akan diadakan bulan Agustus.
english: Based on the meeting results, the annual event will be held in August.
tip: berdasarkan = 'based on' — report language; spoken: dari hasil rapat.

target: Perusahaan kami bergerak di bidang jasa pengiriman barang.
english: Our company operates in the field of goods delivery services.
tip: bergerak di bidang = 'operates in the field of' — company-profile phrase, letters only.

target: Mohon maaf, permintaan Bapak belum dapat kami penuhi saat ini.
english: We are sorry, Sir; we cannot yet fulfill your request at this time.
tip: belum dapat kami penuhi = the polite refusal of letters; spoken: maaf, belum bisa.

target: Segala biaya perjalanan akan ditanggung oleh pihak perusahaan.
english: All travel costs will be borne by the company.
tip: pihak = 'party, side' (pihak perusahaan = the company) — contract wording, not speech.

target: Apabila ada pertanyaan, silakan hubungi bagian administrasi kami.
english: If there are any questions, please contact our administration department.
tip: apabila = formal 'if' — letters and rules; in conversation always kalau.

target: Surat keterangan kerja ini dibuat untuk dipergunakan sebagaimana mestinya.
english: This employment certificate is issued to be used as appropriate.
tip: sebagaimana mestinya = 'as it should be used' — boilerplate closing official certificates.

target: Dilarang merokok di seluruh area gedung ini.
english: Smoking is prohibited throughout this building.
tip: Sign register: dilarang = 'it is prohibited' — spoken: tidak boleh merokok di sini.

target: Harap antre dengan tertib di belakang garis ini.
english: Please queue in an orderly manner behind this line.
tip: dengan tertib = 'in an orderly way' — sign language; spoken: antre yang rapi ya.

target: Mohon maaf atas ketidaknyamanannya, lift sedang dalam perbaikan.
english: We apologize for the inconvenience; the elevator is under repair.
tip: ketidaknyamanan = 'inconvenience' — apology-notice word built from tidak nyaman.

target: Dilarang membuang sampah di sungai, pelanggar akan didenda.
english: Throwing trash in the river is forbidden; violators will be fined.
tip: pelanggar = 'violator', from melanggar (break a rule) — sign and law vocabulary.

target: Isilah formulir ini dengan huruf cetak dan tinta hitam.
english: Fill in this form in block letters and black ink.
tip: -lah on isilah = polite written command — forms say isilah, people say tolong diisi.

target: Kolom tanda tangan harap diisi oleh pemohon sendiri.
english: The signature field should be filled in by the applicant themselves.
tip: pemohon = 'the applicant', from memohon — form vocabulary; spoken: yang mengajukan.

target: Lampirkan fotokopi kartu identitas pada formulir pendaftaran Anda.
english: Attach a photocopy of your identity card to your registration form.
tip: Commands drop the me- prefix: forms say lampirkan (attach), not melampirkan. Any me-...-kan verb loses me- when it becomes an instruction.

target: Dilarang berjualan di sepanjang trotoar ini.
english: Selling is prohibited along this sidewalk.
tip: Dilarang + verb is the sign formula for 'No ...-ing': dilarang berjualan = no selling. Swap in another verb and you can read most street signs.

target: Harap tenang, ujian sedang berlangsung di ruangan ini.
english: Please be quiet; an exam is in progress in this room.
tip: sedang berlangsung = 'is in progress' — notice-board phrase; spoken: lagi ada ujian.

target: Pengunjung dilarang membawa makanan dan minuman ke dalam museum.
english: Visitors are forbidden to bring food and drinks into the museum.
tip: Signs speak formally: pengunjung dilarang membawa makanan. Said aloud, the same rule is just tidak boleh bawa makanan – the formal noun dropped, membawa clipped to bawa.

target: Area ini khusus untuk pemegang kartu anggota.
english: This area is exclusively for membership card holders.
tip: Sign word: pemegang kartu = 'card holder' (peN- = the holder) — spoken: yang punya kartu anggota.

target: Mohon lepas alas kaki sebelum memasuki musala.
english: Please remove your footwear before entering the prayer room.
tip: alas kaki = 'footwear', the sign word — everyone actually says sepatu dan sandal.

target: Kawasan ini bebas asap rokok mulai bulan ini.
english: This area is smoke-free starting this month.
tip: kawasan = official 'zone, area' — signs say kawasan bebas rokok; spoken: daerah.

target: Simpan barang berharga Anda di dalam loker yang tersedia.
english: Store your valuables in the lockers provided.
tip: yang tersedia = 'that are provided, available' — notice phrasing; spoken: yang ada.

target: Harap matikan telepon genggam selama pertunjukan berlangsung.
english: Please switch off mobile phones while the performance is in progress.
tip: telepon genggam = official 'mobile phone' — in real life everyone says HP (ha-pe).

target: Pintu ini hanya untuk keadaan darurat, jangan dibuka sembarangan.
english: This door is only for emergencies; do not open it carelessly.
tip: keadaan darurat = 'an emergency situation' — keadaan makes nouns sound official.

target: Setiap pengunjung wajib mengenakan masker di dalam rumah sakit.
english: Every visitor is required to wear a mask inside the hospital.
tip: wajib = 'must (by rule)' — sign word; spoken: harus pakai masker.
